thresholds.label: Спящий
thresholds.manifestation: Only permanent seven broken concentric black rings and dense roots under RIGHT inner forearm, normal baseline face/body; ZERO contract skin-contact disease.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Innate unexplained unease around Shiki is independent of the pact and works only when an NPC actually perceives his presence.

thresholds.label: Первые сосудистые тени
thresholds.manifestation: Subtle darkened superficial vessels close to RIGHT wrist and forearm mark, gradual additional thin branching there; ordinary physiology, strength and competence unchanged. Other changes subtle and not instantly obvious.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: Intermittent faint odor when facing Shiki close up: stagnant medical room and damp stone; never a long-range locator.
thresholds.psychological_impression: At recognized close presence, unease sometimes acquires an inexpressible sense that something will die slowly and painfully. No autonomic fear attack.

thresholds.label: Бледность
thresholds.manifestation: Gradual sustained skin paleness, beginning darkening of under-eye skin and slight hollowing visible only on close inspection; still NO contact-transmission ability. No itching, fever, altered pain/taste or pathologic body heat. Layered unnatural scent begins as approved at previous stage.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: At normal conversational range in still air an understated scent of a closed ward, damp soil and faint decay may be perceptible, not always present.
thresholds.psychological_impression: During actual proximity or interaction, occasional visceral foreboding of choking, agony and a protracted end, individual NPC reactions. No automatic panic.

thresholds.label: Истощённый силуэт
thresholds.manifestation: Recognizable gaunt appearance forms slowly, shadowed eyes, increasingly visible superficial veins under thin skin on wrists/forearms; no muscular or strength nerf, Zero Genome retained. Rootlike tattoo traces may progress to covered upper arm/trunk, NEVER facial skin.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: At conversational arm's length, an identifiable but restrained scent: stale hospital air, wet earth and a faint organic decay note, with distant metallic or medicinal undertones. Near Shiki while noticed; no persistent airborne plume or scent trail. Coexists with, and is secondary to, the stronger death-agony foreboding.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Current stage: a restrained, psychologically uncanny conviction, for some NPCs, that lingering sick agony and approaching death are somehow close. Express through their body language and personal history, never universal fear.
thresholds.direct_skin_contact_precursor: Confirmed played in session 6 (s6.played.017 and .018): after several seconds of sustained bare living skin contact with Shiki at stage 3, a transient local vascular / toxin-like reaction CAN occur in contacted person's skin: ashen-gray discoloration and thin branching dark superficial vascular pattern. The marks fade gradually after the contact ends. This is a real physical change, separate from psychological dread. It is not yet the systemic chakra-disease infection of stage 5. Precursor strength and occurrence depend on contact duration and conditions; no guaranteed reaction to every light touch.
thresholds.contract_blood_phenotype: Прямое уточнение игрока 17.11.2026: на стадии 3 формируются внутренние тёмные чакроориентированные клеточно-фибриновые микросети в крови/сгустках самого Шики, даже при отсутствии чужих тканей. Это самостоятельное проявление Договора Семи Запоров, НЕ следствие внедрения биоптатов Аракавы и НЕ побочный результат Нулевого Генома. Внешние стимулы могут менять рисунок, но не создавать его. Кровь снаружи обычного красного цвета, гемостаз, газотранспорт, физические способности сохранены; на стадии 3 инфекционного действия крови нет; будущий порог на стадии 5 установлен поздней поправкой.

thresholds.label: Чёрные сосуды
thresholds.manifestation: Deepened nonreversible gaunt/pale shape, prominent dark superficial vessels at neck/trunk, visual ink roots may reach NECK but NEVER FACE. STILL no harmful skin-to-skin transmission until stage 5. No fever, taste/pain loss or abnormal heat. Unusual cold-mineral smoke scent develops at stage-appropriate intensity.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: During prolonged close personal contact the musty medical/earth/decay accord gains intensity, without range extension, stealth penalty or infection.
thresholds.psychological_impression: As outward pallor and vessel marks progress, perceived closeness may intensify dread of a slow painful death; depends on who notices and context.
thresholds.contract_blood_phenotype: Постепенно кровь Шики при кровотечении заметно темнеет до тёмно-бордового цвета; при свёртывании часть организованных чакрочувствительных тёмных нитей доступна обычному зрению. На стадии 4 кровь ещё НЕ заразна. Гемостаз и газотранспорт полноценны.

thresholds.label: Активный контактный синдром
thresholds.manifestation: The earlier stage-3 reversible local vascular reaction remains possible; only NOW possible to transfer abnormal chakra disease through unprotected DIRECT LIVING BARE SKIN against LIVING BARE SKIN. Chance and severity contextual, no guaranteed infection and no automatic contagious contact through gloves or clothes. New direct player ruling: an additional direct route through fresh Shiki blood into an open wound or living mucosa; never airborne or dried-fomite transmission.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: In direct close quarters the same signature is recognizable; it does not transmit disease via smell. Stage5 bare-living-skin-contact hazard remains separate.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Dread as before plus separately gated possible bare-skin contact illness; emotional signal itself never transmits disease or acts as genjutsu.
thresholds.contract_blood_phenotype: Кровь Шики тёмно-бордовая, с различимыми чёрными микронитями сгустка. По позднему прямому указанию игрока СВЕЖАЯ кровь начинает переносить болезнь Договора при прямом попадании в открытую рану или на слизистую живого реципиента. Это дополнительный путь к голому контакту кожи; не гарантированная мгновенная инфекция. Нет передачи через воздух, запах, высохшие следы и предметы.

thresholds.label: Устойчивая тяжёлая форма
thresholds.manifestation: Permanent conspicuous gauntness, dark hollows and vessels, extended roots on neck/trunk but never FACE; both the skin route and direct fresh blood-to-open-wound/mucosa hazard continue. NO fixed disease symptoms beyond approved phenotype, no stat nerf, no preordained terminal collapse.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: More distinct during direct close encounters, never a spreading cloud or persistent following trail; still no infectious aerosol or spontaneous tissue rot.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Presence can inspire sharper associations of helpless, prolonged dying in those who clearly see/interact with him, with autonomous varied responses.
thresholds.contract_blood_phenotype: Кровь продолжает темнеть, внутри зрелого сгустка может выглядеть почти чернильной; функцией крови и мышечной силой Шики распоряжается полноценно. Сохраняется заразность свежей крови при прямом контакте с открытой раной/слизистой, не аэрозоль и не фомиты.

timing_and_agency.skin_route: Stage3: sustained bare living skin contact may induce transient local ashen discoloration/branching veins, but NO systemic infection and blood NOT infectious. Stage4: gradual visible blood darkening, still noninfectious. Gloves/cloth are barriers to ordinary skin contact. No airborne, odor, dried-blood, object, tool, indirect/fomite, or epidemic propagation. Do not automatically infect any brief direct exposure.
excluded: No abnormal warm skin, fever, altered taste or pain reduction as background pact side effects. Unusual scent APPROVED 2026-11-15 and staged separately
No reduction of battle movement, medical skill, intelligence, stamina stats solely because of gaunt appearance
Never place tattoo roots onto Shiki's face
